$description: Key art for the Yawmuk brand. AI-generated (disclosed per the competition AI-disclosure rule). Not photographs of real places or people. Reviewed by hand: no text, no calligraphy, no Quran/hadith, no crescent symbols, no identifiable faces.
generator: OpenAI built-in image_gen tool, invoked via Codex CLI (codex exec, model gpt-5.5)
postProcessing: Resized with Pillow (LANCZOS) and saved as progressive JPEG q82 (town/courtyard 1600x900, home 1200x1200).
license: Generated for Team Lemonada's Yawmuk entry; no third-party assets embedded. Usage subject to OpenAI's terms for generated output.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: key art, 16:9 landscape PNG
Primary request: a small, friendly modern American neighbourhood at golden hour seen from a gentle high angle: a family house with a porch, a tree-lined street, a modest school building with a flag pole with no text anywhere, a small corner bank, and in the distance a modest contemporary neighbourhood mosque with a simple dome and a slim minaret, all connected by one winding sidewalk path that suggests a journey through a single day. Sun low and warm on the horizon.
Style/medium: premium stylized 3D diorama render, soft clay/matte materials, gentle low-poly geometry with rounded bevels, polished indie 3D game look, not cartoonish, not photoreal.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, editorial composition, generous negative sky space, gentle high angle, clear winding path linking the house, school, bank, and distant mosque.
Lighting/mood: warm golden-hour daylight, soft long shadows, subtle atmospheric haze, calm and welcoming.
Color palette: deep teal ink #0B2224, warm sun amber #F2B43C, olive-emerald green #2F8F74, sand paper cream #F3EAD7, terracotta clay #D9714E, soft dusk sky blue #A6C8EC.
Materials/textures: matte clay surfaces, rounded bevels, soft low-poly trees and buildings, warm stone and wood accents.
Constraints: absolutely no text, no letters, no calligraphy, no signage words, no logos, no crescent-moon symbols, no human faces; people may appear only as tiny distant faceless figures.
Avoid: cartoonish exaggeration, photorealism, readable signs, religious text, flags with text or symbols, watermarks.

Absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no flags of any country, no crescent symbols, no human faces; people only as tiny distant faceless figures.
revision.postProcessing: Centre-cropped to 16:9, resized to 1600x900 with Pillow (LANCZOS), progressive JPEG q82. Reviewed by hand: no flag, no text, no faces.
